note: Large spice erupts at one catalogued site at a time and shifts when harvested out or drawn off by the sandworm. Sites confirmed in-game on our own server (public maps differ). The live active field is now keyed by its authoritative field_id from the DB: when the active field_id matches a recorded survey below, its sector is pinned authoritatively; when it changes (a rotation), the map shows the field as active but awaiting a fresh survey, shaded to the legal band (rows D-I) rather than guessing. Position itself is never stored server-side (RE 2026-06-07), so the exact sector still comes from one survey per field_id.
active_help: Survey cache: per dimension index ("0"=PvE, "1"=PvP), record the sector you see in-game together with the field_id the live producer reports for that dimension at that moment. Match -> authoritative pin. Example: {"0": {"sector": "H5", "field_id": "<19-digit id from the live producer>", "confirmed_utc": "..."}}.
